definitions.gloss: ground blizzard; drifting snow; snow blown along the ground by wind
definitions.explanation: A weather phenomenon where strong winds blow fallen snow along the ground surface, severely reducing visibility. Unlike a regular blizzard, no new snow is falling — it is existing snow being swept up by wind.

examples.japanese: {地吹雪|じふぶき}で{前|まえ}が{見|み}えない。
examples.english: I can't see ahead because of the ground blizzard.

examples.japanese: {地吹雪|じふぶき}のため、{道路|どうろ}が{通行止|つうこうど}めになった。
examples.english: The road was closed due to the ground blizzard.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}では{冬|ふゆ}になると{地吹雪|じふぶき}が{発生|はっせい}しやすく、{運転|うんてん}には{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, ground blizzards are common in winter, and caution is needed when driving.

notes:
A compound of {地|じ} (ground) + {吹雪|ふぶき} (blizzard, snowstorm). Describes a specific type of snow event where wind blows existing snow along the ground.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}が{発生|はっせい}する: for a ground blizzard to occur
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}で{視界|しかい}が{悪|わる}い: visibility is poor due to ground blizzard
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}{注意報|ちゅういほう}: ground blizzard advisory
- {激|はげ}しい{地吹雪|じふぶき}: severe ground blizzard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吹雪|ふぶき}: blizzard, snowstorm — a broader term for any heavy snowfall with strong wind
- {猛吹雪|もうふぶき}: fierce blizzard — an extremely intense snowstorm
- {風雪|ふうせつ}: wind and snow — a general term for windy, snowy conditions
